banned.claim: 'Zero impact' or 'carbon neutral' packaging or products
banned.why: FTC Green Guides - unverifiable environmental benefit claim
FTC Green Guides - no recycled-content sourcing stated or verified

banned.claim: 'Hypoallergenic - prevents all skin reactions' or medical skin claims
banned.why: Medical claim; hypoallergenic can be stated but not as a guaranteed no-reaction cure
Overstates the waterproof/tarnish-free claim beyond what the site substantiates
